parameter_sources.capacity_mm: FAO-56 Ch.8: ~150 mm plant-available water per metre of loamy root zone (typical published range 100-200).
parameter_sources.cn_ii: USDA TR-55 Table 2-2: mid-range CN for mixed semi-urban/agricultural land use (pervious, good condition).
parameter_sources.depletion_fraction: FAO-56 Ch.8 Table 22: p=0.5 general / deep-rooted crops.
parameter_sources.initial_storage_mm: Documented warm-start; results reported after 3-month spin-up, initial condition stored verbatim in provenance.
parameter_sources.krs: FAO-56 Ch.4: kRS=0.0023 for interior regions (Bengaluru is inland Karnataka).

equations.equation: Q = (P - 0.2S)^2 / (P + 0.8S); S = 25400/CN - 254; CN adjusted for AMC via 5-day antecedent rainfall
equations.source: USDA SCS NRCS NEH-4 (curve number method)

equations.equation: S(t+1) = S(t) + P - AET - Q - Drainage (0 <= S <= capacity)
equations.source: conceptual single-layer bucket; FAO-56 Ch.8 water balance

provenance.note: All state variables are model outputs (SIMULATED). Forcing is REAL observed data; model outputs are never written to ObservationStore/ForecastStore/HazardStore/AlertStore.
